name: failure-register
summary: Read-only register of failures that keep coming back: groups failures by job, step and reason with times, ids and paths removed, and lists any signature seen in 3 or more separate incidents. Never opens a ticket.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (reads $HUBKIT_HOME/state/failures.jsonl, writes failure-register.md and failure-register.tick beside it)
